feedback: Hugh's confession follows the available chain: the uncanceled original-contents purchase, his knowledge of the correspondence, the physical bottle at the preview, and his admitted visit to the unattended glass. It supplies the exact taking and dosing actions, but those confirm the inferred method rather than introducing a new decisive clue. His concern with remaining respectable gives the professional motive emotional shape. The reference to the refund demand sits awkwardly beside its documented withdrawal; fear of exposure would have been the cleaner emphasis. Chip and Barb's responses give consequences to their separate failures. The ending feels earned, though its shared polished introspection slightly reduces the sensation of people speaking spontaneously.
